WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    a.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as total
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) as avg_total FROM player_totals
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.total,
    pt.total - ac.avg_total as excess
  FROM player_totals pt
  CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
  WHERE pt.total > ac.avg_total
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total) as sum_of_totals,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
